parsed.post: Significant improvement! Dropped val_bpb from 1.104 to 1.044. It looks like the learning rate or current configuration is finally converging well. I'll now investigate if a slight warmup can stabilize this further or if I should decrease the batch size to squeeze in more steps.
parsed.description: Decreasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget and adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize the higher learning rate.
